Messages.Author: Ted Prodromou
Messages.Body:
Thetmes, Basilia, and the Gangrel antitribu chick all do aggravated hand
damage.

If they wield Bang Nakh, does it do aggravated damage too?

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:


No. The damage from Bang Nakh (like all weapons' damage) isn't hand
damage.
